description: Current and upcoming bus detours, suspensions, moved stops and extra services in a city or on the InterCity coaches, with the routes and stops they affect, plus the latest operator news. Example: city "Taipei"; or city "Taipei", route "307".

city.description: City: a TDX code (Taipei, NewTaipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, Kaohsiung, Keelung, Hsinchu, HsinchuCounty, MiaoliCounty, ChanghuaCounty, NantouCounty, YunlinCounty, ChiayiCounty, Chiayi, PingtungCounty, YilanCounty, HualienCounty, TaitungCounty, KinmenCounty, PenghuCounty, LienchiangCounty) or its Chinese name (臺北市, 新北市, ...), or "InterCity" for 公路客運 / 國道客運 coaches between cities.

keyword.description: Only alerts mentioning this, e.g. a stop or a road ("市政府", "遊行").

limit.description: Maximum number of alerts to return (default 20).

route.description: Only alerts that affect this route, e.g. "307".

name: bus_alerts
title: Bus service alerts
